BindIdentityProvider.description_en: Binds an upstream identity provider to a specified instance and triggers a synchronization task
BindIdentityProvider.description_zh: 为指定实例绑定上游身份提供商并触发同步任务

ConfigureNatGateway.description_en: Activates and configures an Internet NAT gateway for a specified AgentTeams instance
ConfigureNatGateway.description_zh: 为指定AgentTeams实例开通并配置阿里云公网NAT网关

CreateCredential.description_en: Creates a new key-value credential under a specified AgentTeams instance
CreateCredential.description_zh: 在指定AgentTeams实例下创建新的Key-Value凭证

CreateInstance.description_en: Asynchronously creates a cluster instance with the specified configurations
CreateInstance.description_zh: 用于异步创建指定配置的集群实例

CreateModel.description_en: Creates an AI model under a specified AgentTeams instance. You must specify the model name, the model provider, and the list of supported protocols
CreateModel.description_zh: 用于在指定 AgentTeams 实例下创建 AI 模型，需指定模型名称、所属模型供应商及支持的协议列表

CreateModelProvider.description_en: Creates an AI model provider under a specified AgentTeams instance. You must specify the provider name, address, supported protocol list, and API keys
CreateModelProvider.description_zh: 用于在指定 AgentTeams 实例下创建 AI 模型供应商，需指定供应商名称、地址、支持的协议列表及 API 密钥

CreateServiceEndpoint.description_en: Creates an endpoint for a specified instance. Multiple component types and gateway types are supported
CreateServiceEndpoint.description_zh: 用于创建指定实例的Endpoint，支持多种组件和网关类型

CreateTeam.description_en: Creates a team under a specified instance. You can set the team name, description, administrator, and initial member list
CreateTeam.description_zh: 用于在指定实例下创建团队，支持设置团队名称、描述、管理员和初始成员列表

CreateUser.description_en: Creates a user under a specified instance. You can set the username, display name, email address, authentication method, note, and password. If no password is specified, the system automatically generates an initial password and returns it in the response
CreateUser.description_zh: 用于在指定实例下创建用户，支持设置用户名、显示名称、邮箱、认证方式、备注和密码等信息。如果未指定密码，系统将自动生成初始密码并在响应中返回

CreateWorker.description_en: Creates a Worker instance with specified configurations such as model, skills, template, MCP servers, and channels
CreateWorker.description_zh: 用于创建一个 Worker 实例，指定模型、技能、模板、MCP 服务器、渠道等配置

CreateWorkerBootstrapToken.description_en: Creates a local management bootstrap token for a Worker, with support for specifying the network type
CreateWorkerBootstrapToken.description_zh: 用于为 Worker 创建本地纳管启动 Token，支持指定网络类型

DeleteCredential.description_en: Deletes an existing credential from a specified AgentTeams instance. The credential cannot be deleted if it is still attached to a Worker
DeleteCredential.description_zh: 用于删除指定 AgentTeams 实例下已存在的凭证，若凭证仍被 Worker 绑定则不允许删除

DeleteInstance.description_en: Releases a specified AgentTeams instance and cleans up related resources. Supports GET and POST methods. After a successful call, the instance status changes to DELETING, and resource cleanup is performed asynchronously in the background
DeleteInstance.description_zh: 用于释放指定的 AgentTeams 实例并清理相关资源。支持 GET 和 POST 方法，成功调用后实例状态将更改为 DELETING，资源清理由后台异步执行

DeleteMcp.description_en: Deletes an MCP server from a specified AgentTeams instance. The server cannot be deleted if it is associated with any Workers
DeleteMcp.description_zh: 用于删除指定 AgentTeams 实例下的 MCP 服务器，若存在关联的 Worker 则无法删除

DeleteModel.description_en: Deletes an AI model from a specified AgentTeams instance. The model cannot be deleted if it is still associated with a Worker
DeleteModel.description_zh: 用于删除指定 AgentTeams 实例下的 AI 模型，若模型仍有关联的 Worker 则无法删除

DeleteModelProvider.description_en: Deletes an AI model provider from a specified AgentTeams instance. The provider cannot be deleted if it still has associated models
DeleteModelProvider.description_zh: 用于删除指定 AgentTeams 实例下的 AI 模型供应商，若供应商仍有关联的模型则无法删除

DeleteServiceEndpoint.description_en: Deletes an endpoint from a specified AgentTeams instance and cleans up related resources
DeleteServiceEndpoint.description_zh: 用于删除指定AgentTeams实例下的endpoint，并清理相关资源

DeleteTeam.description_en: Deletes a team under a specified instance. After deletion, the team and associated resources enter an asynchronous cleanup process
DeleteTeam.description_zh: 用于删除指定实例下的团队，删除后团队及关联资源进入异步清理流程

DeleteUser.description_en: Deletes a specified user from a specified instance. After deletion, the user cannot log on to or access instance resources. Proceed with caution
DeleteUser.description_zh: 用于删除指定实例下的指定用户。删除后用户将无法登录和访问实例资源，请谨慎操作

DeleteWorker.description_en: Deletes a Worker under a specified instance
DeleteWorker.description_zh: 用于删除指定实例下的 Worker

GetCredential.description_en: Queries the details of a specified credential under an AgentTeams instance, including the status, description, and list of bound Workers
GetCredential.description_zh: 用于查询指定 AgentTeams 实例下某个凭证的详细信息，包括状态、描述以及已绑定 Worker 列表

GetIdentityProvider.description_en: Queries the binding details of an upstream identity provider for a specified instance and identity provider type, including the logon callback URL and metadata
GetIdentityProvider.description_zh: 用于查询指定实例与身份提供商类型的上游身份提供商绑定详情，包含登录回调地址与元数据等信息

GetInstance.description_en: Queries the details of a specified instance by instance ID. Supports GET and POST methods. A successful response returns the detailed configuration and status of the instance
GetInstance.description_zh: 通过实例 ID 查询指定实例的详细信息。支持 GET 和 POST 方法，成功响应返回实例的详细配置信息及状态

GetInstanceAsyncTask.description_en: Queries the status of asynchronous tasks associated with a specified AgentTeams instance, with pagination support
GetInstanceAsyncTask.description_zh: 用于查询指定AgentTeams实例关联的异步任务状态，支持分页

GetInstanceOssMountRamAuthorizeUrl.description_en: Retrieves the RAM authorization URL required to mount OSS to ACS for an instance
GetInstanceOssMountRamAuthorizeUrl.description_zh: 用于获取实例 OSS 挂载到 ACS 所需的 RAM 授权链接

GetMcp.description_en: Queries the details of a specified MCP server, including the address, authentication configuration, deployment status, and protocol
GetMcp.description_zh: 用于查询指定 MCP 服务器的详细信息，包括地址、鉴权配置、部署状态和协议等

GetModelInvocationSummary.description_en: Queries the model call summary for a specified AgentTeams instance within a specified time range, including today's and this week's call counts, change rates, call frequency, and provider distribution
GetModelInvocationSummary.description_zh: 用于查询指定 AgentTeams 实例在指定时间范围内的模型调用摘要，包括今日和本周调用次数、变化率、调用频率及供应商分布

GetModelProvider.description_en: Queries the details of a single AI model provider, including the name, address, protocol list, API keys, and deployment status
GetModelProvider.description_zh: 用于查询单个 AI 模型供应商的详细信息，包括名称、地址、协议列表、API 密钥、部署状态等

GetNatGatewayStatus.description_en: Queries the configuration status of the NAT gateway and its SNAT rules for a specified instance
GetNatGatewayStatus.description_zh: 用于查询指定实例的NAT网关及其SNAT规则的配置状态

GetServiceEndpoint.description_en: Queries the details of an endpoint with a specified ID. You can verify the endpoint by instance ID
GetServiceEndpoint.description_zh: 查询指定ID的Endpoint详细信息，支持通过实例ID进行校验

GetTaskStatsSummary.description_en: Queries the task statistics summary of a specified AgentTeams instance within a specified time range, including total tasks, average task duration, token consumption, and status distribution
GetTaskStatsSummary.description_zh: 用于查询指定 AgentTeams 实例在指定时间范围内的任务统计摘要，包括总任务数、平均任务时长、Token 消耗量及状态分布

GetTeam.description_en: Queries the details of a specified team under a specified instance, including the description, administrator, leader, members, associated workers, and room status
GetTeam.description_zh: 用于查询指定实例下某个团队的详细信息，包括描述、管理员、负责人、成员、关联 Worker 及房间状态等

GetTokenTrend.description_en: Queries the token consumption trend of a specified AgentTeams instance within a specified time range, supports grouping by time dimension, and returns time series data that can be used for charting
GetTokenTrend.description_zh: 用于查询指定 AgentTeams 实例在指定时间范围内的 Token 消耗趋势，支持按时间维度分组，返回可用于绘图的时序数据

GetToolCallDistribution.description_en: Queries the tool calling distribution of a specified AgentTeams instance within a specified time range, and returns the number of calls for each tool and the total number of calls
GetToolCallDistribution.description_zh: 用于查询指定 AgentTeams 实例在指定时间范围内的工具调用分布，返回各工具的调用次数和总调用次数

GetUser.description_en: Queries the details of a specified user under a specified instance, including the username, display name, email address, authentication method, status, and creation time
GetUser.description_zh: 用于查询指定实例下指定用户的详细信息，包括用户名、显示名称、邮箱、认证方式、状态和创建时间等

GetUserPassword.description_en: Retrieves the initial password of a specified user under a specified instance. The initial password is generated by the system or specified by the user when the user is created
GetUserPassword.description_zh: 用于获取指定实例下指定用户的初始密码。初始密码在创建用户时由系统生成或由用户指定

GetWorker.description_en: Queries the details of a specified worker, including configurations such as model, skills, sub-agents, MCP servers, channels, and quotas
GetWorker.description_zh: 用于查询指定 Worker 的详细信息，包括模型、技能、子 Agent、MCP 服务器、渠道、限额等配置

GetWorkerBootstrapOptions.description_en: Queries the startup options for local Worker management and returns available network types
GetWorkerBootstrapOptions.description_zh: 用于查询 Worker 本地纳管启动选项，返回可用的网络类型

GetWorkerMaxVersion.description_en: Queries the maximum upgradable version of a worker
GetWorkerMaxVersion.description_zh: 用于查询 Worker 最大可升级版本

GetWorkerStatsSummary.description_en: Queries the Worker statistics summary, including the total number of workers, the number of running workers, the number of stopped workers, and more
GetWorkerStatsSummary.description_zh: 用于查询 Worker 统计摘要，包括总数、运行中、已停止等数量

ListCredentials.description_en: Queries the credential list under a specified AgentTeams instance with paging, returning credential summary information and the number of Workers attached to each credential
ListCredentials.description_zh: 用于分页查询指定 AgentTeams 实例下的凭证列表，返回凭证摘要信息及各自绑定的 Worker 数量

ListIdentityProviders.description_en: Queries the list of upstream identity provider bindings for a specified instance, with support for paginated responses
ListIdentityProviders.description_zh: 用于查询指定实例的上游身份提供商绑定列表，支持分页返回

ListInstances.description_en: Queries a list of instances that meet the specified conditions. Supports pagination and fuzzy match. Supports GET and POST methods. The list is returned in reverse chronological order by creation time
ListInstances.description_zh: 用于查询符合条件的实例列表，并支持分页和模糊匹配。支持 GET 和 POST 方法，列表按创建时间倒序返回

ListMcpTools.description_en: Queries the list of tools provided by a specified MCP server, including tool names, titles, descriptions, and input schemas
ListMcpTools.description_zh: 用于查询指定 MCP 服务器提供的工具列表，包括工具名称、标题、描述和输入 schema

ListMcps.description_en: Queries the MCP server list under a specified AgentTeams instance by using paging
ListMcps.description_zh: 用于分页查询指定 AgentTeams 实例下的 MCP 服务器列表

ListModelProviders.description_en: Queries the list of AI model providers under a specified AgentTeams instance. Paging is supported
ListModelProviders.description_zh: 用于查询指定 AgentTeams 实例下的 AI 模型供应商列表，支持分页查询

ListModels.description_en: Queries the list of AI models under a specified AgentTeams instance. You can filter results by model name or provider name, and paging is supported
ListModels.description_zh: 用于查询指定 AgentTeams 实例下的 AI 模型列表，支持按模型名称、供应商名称过滤，并支持分页查询

ListServiceEndpoints.description_en: Queries the list of AI gateway endpoints under a specified instance
ListServiceEndpoints.description_zh: 此API用于查询指定实例下的AI网关端点列表

ListSslCerts.description_en: Queries the list of SSL certificates available to the user in APIG
ListSslCerts.description_zh: 查询用户侧APIG可用的SSL证书列表

ListTeamDetails.description_en: Queries the statistical details of teams under a specified instance, including aggregate metrics such as the number of workers, number of tasks, success rate, and token usage for each team
ListTeamDetails.description_zh: 用于查询指定实例下团队的统计详情列表，包含每个团队的 Worker 数量、任务数量、成功率及 Token 用量等聚合指标

ListTeamTasks.description_en: Queries the task list of a specified team under a specified instance. The task metadata is sourced from the OSS bucket bound to the instance
ListTeamTasks.description_zh: 用于查询指定实例下某个团队的任务列表，任务元数据来源于实例绑定的 OSS 存储桶

ListTeams.description_en: Queries the list of teams under a specified instance, with support for fuzzy filtering by name and pagination
ListTeams.description_zh: 用于查询指定实例下的团队列表，支持按名称模糊过滤及分页

ListUsers.description_en: Queries the list of users under a specified instance. Supports fuzzy match by username and paging query. The list is returned in reverse chronological order by creation time
ListUsers.description_zh: 用于查询指定实例下的用户列表，支持按用户名模糊匹配和分页查询。列表按创建时间倒序返回

ListWorkerStatsDetails.description_en: Queries a list of Worker statistics details by paging, including task count, token usage, and LLM call count
ListWorkerStatsDetails.description_zh: 用于分页查询 Worker 统计详情列表，包括任务数、Token 用量、LLM 调用次数等

ListWorkers.description_en: Queries the list of Workers under a specified instance by using paging, with support for filtering by name, model, template, and other conditions
ListWorkers.description_zh: 用于分页查询指定实例下的 Worker 列表，支持按名称、模型、模板等条件过滤

PutCmsWorkspace.description_en: Creates or updates a CMS workspace
PutCmsWorkspace.description_zh: 用于创建或更新CMS工作空间

QueryFeatures.description_en: Queries the attribute status of a specified instance, worker, team, or individual
QueryFeatures.description_zh: 用于查询指定实例、worker、团队或个人的功能特性状态

QuerySupportedZones.description_en: Retrieves all zone IDs supported by the current AgentTeams Resource Pool configuration
QuerySupportedZones.description_zh: 用于获取当前AgentTeams Resource Pool配置支持的所有可用区ID

ResetUserPassword.description_en: Resets the password of a specified user under a specified instance. After the reset, the user must log on with the new password
ResetUserPassword.description_zh: 用于重置指定实例下指定用户的密码。重置后用户需使用新密码登录

TestModelProvider.description_en: Tests the connectivity of an AI model provider and model under a specified AgentTeams instance by sending a test prompt and returning the call result, latency, and token usage
TestModelProvider.description_zh: 用于测试指定 AgentTeams 实例下 AI 模型供应商和模型的连通性，发送一条测试 Prompt 并返回调用结果、延迟和 Token 用量

UnbindIdentityProvider.description_en: Unbinds the upstream identity provider from a specified instance, dissociates the identity federation relationship, and cleans up associated user identities and data
UnbindIdentityProvider.description_zh: 用于解绑指定实例的上游身份提供商，解除身份集成关系并清理关联的用户身份与数据

UpdateCredential.description_en: Updates the plaintext key of an existing credential in an AgentTeams instance
UpdateCredential.description_zh: 用于更新 AgentTeams 实例下已有凭证的密钥明文

UpdateIdentityProvider.description_en: Updates the upstream identity provider configuration bound to a specified instance. You can adjust the logon switch and user synchronization switch
UpdateIdentityProvider.description_zh: 用于更新指定实例已绑定的上游身份提供商配置，支持调整登录开关与用户同步开关

UpdateInstance.description_en: Changes the name of a specified AgentTeams instance. This operation supports GET and POST methods. You can only modify the instance name through this operation. You cannot change the namespace through this operation
UpdateInstance.description_zh: 用于更改指定 AgentTeams 实例的名称，支持通过 GET 或 POST 方法调用。该接口仅允许修改实例名称，不允许通过此接口变更命名空间

UpdateInstanceAsyncTask.description_en: Restarts a paused asynchronous task for creating an instance
UpdateInstanceAsyncTask.description_zh: 用于重启暂停中的创建实例异步任务

UpdateMcp.description_en: Updates the configuration of a specified MCP server, including the address list, authentication information, and description
UpdateMcp.description_zh: 用于更新指定 MCP 服务器的配置，包括地址列表、鉴权信息和描述等

UpdateModel.description_en: Updates the description and other information of an AI model in a specified AgentTeams instance
UpdateModel.description_zh: 用于更新指定 AgentTeams 实例下 AI 模型的描述等信息

UpdateModelProvider.description_en: Updates the address, protocol list, API key, and other information of an AI model provider in a specified AgentTeams instance
UpdateModelProvider.description_zh: 用于更新指定 AgentTeams 实例下 AI 模型供应商的地址、协议列表、API 密钥等信息

UpdateServiceEndpoint.description_en: Updates the domain name and SSL certificate information for a specified endpoint
UpdateServiceEndpoint.description_zh: 用于更新指定Endpoint的域名和SSL证书信息

UpdateTeam.description_en: Updates the description and member list of a team under a specified instance, and returns the latest team information after the update
UpdateTeam.description_zh: 用于更新指定实例下某个团队的描述与成员列表，更新后返回团队最新信息

UpdateUser.description_en: Updates the information of a specified user under a specified instance, including the display name, email address, authentication method, and remarks
UpdateUser.description_zh: 用于更新指定实例下指定用户的信息，包括显示名称、邮箱、认证方式和备注等

UpdateWorker.description_en: Updates the configuration of a specified Worker, including model, skills, template, MCP servers, channels, and quotas
UpdateWorker.description_zh: 用于更新指定 Worker 的配置，包括模型、技能、模板、MCP 服务器、渠道、限额等
